overview_description.description: Kafy is a B2B food-tech supply chain platform designed to streamline the way food-related businesses order and receive supplies. The KAFY platform connects restaurants, cafés, groceries, catering kitchens, and suppliers to simplify inventory ordering, improve procurement efficiency, and reduce food wastage and operational costs.
